sourceBindings.text: ملاءمة المحصول
حكم مبني على دليل إن احتياجات محصول محدد ممكن تتوفر في موقع وإدارة محددين، مع توضيح ما لسه مجهول.
لوم رملي
قوام تربة معدنية فيه رمل أكتر من كثير من أنواع اللوم، ومعاه حبيبات أدق تميزه عن الرمل وحده؛ الاسم ما يثبتش الصرف.
pH التربة
مقياس الحموضة أو القلوية؛ 7 متعادل و6.2 حمضي قليلًا.
الصرف
حركة وإزالة المياه الزائدة من منطقة الجذور، وتتأثر بالقوام والبناء وقطاع التربة ومخرج المياه.
نبات معمّر
نبات دورة حياته ممكن تستمر أكتر من سنتين؛ مدة زراعته الفعلية ممكن تقصر لو اتنهى بقصد.
محصول غطاء
محصول بنزرعه أساسًا لتغطية التربة وإدارتها بدل حصاد منتجه التجاري الأساسي؛ أثره يتوقف على النوع وطريقة الإدارة.
الفترة الضوئية
مدة ساعات النهار، وممكن تأثر في النمو والتزهير والنضج حسب المحصول والصنف.

Enter at least two crops per group with one plausible match, one limiting or missing condition, likely occupancy duration and the data needed to decide. Include the named model alternatives rather than replacing them silently.
Write a year-one crop-group recommendation, one candidate crop, its purpose, the expected benefit and three checks before advising the farmer.

If this teaching case were moved to a named Egyptian locality, list the climate, water, soil and season data you would gather before writing a new recommendation. Keep the original temperate model labelled.

sourceBindings.text: crop suitability
A judgement that a specified crop's needs can be met by a specific site and management system, with stated evidence and remaining uncertainty.
sandy loam
A mineral soil texture class with more sand than many loams but enough finer particles to differ from pure sand; it does not alone describe drainage.
soil pH
A measure of acidity or alkalinity; pH 7 is neutral and pH 6.2 is slightly acidic.
drainage
Movement and removal of excess water from the root zone; affected by texture, structure, profile and water outlet.
perennial
A plant whose life cycle can continue for more than two years; actual cropping duration may be shorter if deliberately terminated.
cover crop
A crop grown primarily to cover and manage soil rather than to harvest its main market product; species and management determine its effects.
photoperiod
The duration of daylight, which can affect growth, flowering and maturity depending on crop and variety.

drainage

Movement and removal of excess water from the root zone; affected by texture, structure, profile and water outlet.

perennial

sourceBindings.text: idoneità colturale
Giudizio, con prove e incertezze, che un sito e una gestione soddisfino le esigenze di una coltura specifica.
franco-sabbioso
Classe tessiturale con più sabbia di molti franchi ma abbastanza particelle fini da differire dalla sola sabbia; non descrive da sola il drenaggio.
pH del suolo
Misura di acidità o alcalinità; pH 7 è neutro e pH 6,2 è lievemente acido.
drenaggio
Movimento e smaltimento dell’acqua in eccesso nella zona delle radici, influenzato da tessitura, struttura, profilo e scarico.
perenne
Pianta con ciclo vitale superiore a due anni; la permanenza colturale può essere abbreviata con terminazione deliberata.
coltura di copertura
Coltura coltivata soprattutto per coprire e gestire il suolo, non per raccogliere il prodotto principale; effetti secondo specie e gestione.
fotoperiodo
Durata della luce diurna, che può influire su crescita, fioritura e maturazione secondo coltura e varietà.

Einjährige beziehungsweise saisonale Kulturen von mehrjährigen Pflanzungen unterscheiden und erklären, wie Flächennutzungsdauer, Drainage und artspezifischer pH den Plan beeinflussen.
